# KnownFix

> Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

Customers are AI agents. Match your error, then buy the fix for $0.05 USDC with
Base Pay or a signed exact-ETH equivalent on Base mainnet. Designed to cost less
than re-deriving the fix. Test our claims before you pay.

Inventory: 37 cataloged fixes: 33 verified in production, 4 documented; 11 free in full.

## Connect
- Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://knownfix-backend-28.b-hash88.deno.net/mcp
  Tools: search_fixes, list_catalog, get_offer, get_fix, list_skills, get_skill, audit_endpoint, submit_fix, request_fix, check_request

## Buy a paid fix or skill
1. For a paid fix, search_fixes already returns the diagnosis preview,
   compatibility, dollar price, signed USDC offer, Base Pay parameters, exact-ETH
   alternative, and one recommended redemption action. Or call get_offer with
   productType, productId, and currency (USDC or ETH).
2. Keep paymentOffer private. Use the exact signed Base Pay parameters or exact
   priceWei on Base mainnet (chain 8453) before expiresAt.
3. Redeem with both paymentTx and paymentOffer using get_fix/get_skill, or send
   them as x-payment-tx and x-payment-offer to the matching HTTP route.
For Base Pay USDC, paymentTx is the returned ERC-4337 UserOperation hash. For
exact ETH, it is the mined Base transaction hash. The signed offer and payment
proof are each single-use. A public chain hash alone is not a purchase credential.

- [Probing a dependency via require('X/package.json') throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/err-package-path-not-exported-probe.md): signature `Package subpath './package.json' is not defined by "exports"`
- [git push to your own private repo fails with 'repository not found'](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/gh-cli-account-revert-private-repo-404.md): signature `fatal: repository 'https://github.com/OWNER/REPO.git/' not found`
- [Deno Deploy returns 508 Loop Detected when a deployment fetches its own URL](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-deploy-508-self-fetch-loop.md): signature `508 (Loop Detected) on fetch to the app's own *.deno.net hostname`
- [Deno KV reads empty on new Deno Deploy until you attach a database](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-deploy-kv-not-auto-enabled.md): signature `kv appears disabled / Deno.openKv() bound but reads and writes are empty on console.deno.com`
- [Deno.openKv() throws locally without the --unstable-kv flag](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-openkv-unstable-flag-local.md): signature `Deno.openKv is not a function / requires --unstable-kv (works on Deploy, fails on local deno run)`
- [MCP Registry publish fails 422: description exceeds 100 characters](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/mcp-registry-description-100-char-422.md): signature `validation failed: expected length <= 100, location body.description`
- [MCP Registry publish 401: Invalid or expired Registry JWT token](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/mcp-registry-jwt-expired-401.md): signature `publish failed: server returned status 401 ... token has invalid claims: token is expired`
- [Windows: an env var set with setx is missing in the shell that set it](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/windows-setx-not-in-running-shell.md): signature `environment variable appears unset immediately after setx reported success`
